create_ItemCounter: create an ItemCounter instance to track counts of arbitrary items using a dictionary
add_item_ItemCounter: add an item to the ItemCounter to increment its count or initialize it to one
remove_item_ItemCounter: remove an item from the ItemCounter to decrement its count or delete it at zero
review_ItemCounter_class: review the ItemCounter class and its add_item and remove_item methods for counting logic
summarize_ItemCounter: summarize the ItemCounter class as a dictionary wrapper for counting occurrences of items
